summary: Q00014 independently reviewed four immutable producer RESULT_SHAs. However its three exact_hd_source entries are Sonic-TV/OR2006Sprites Release DXT5/BC3 sources, while the current canonical user-HD inventory is localization/graphics/inventory.csv@5a3d3b09d97063c65e2b2e356a20878e4c0a83df and records RGBA source identities for all three assets; index92 is also 512x64 in the canonical inventory versus 2048x256 in the manifest. Current contract requires the user HD source when present. Therefore B00083/C109 Release geometry cannot be reused as canonical source-mask/CLEAN_PLATE geometry. Rebuild indices 92/98/112 from exact canonical HD source bytes; semantic text may be reused, pixel geometry may not.

The stock measurements remain reconstruction priors only and do not replace canonical HD Release/source gates. The immutable RESULT_SHA 9214bd9b00df6e4695a5edef27266a22699c1908 contains only the material report and no docs/automation/runs/LOCALIZATION-LOCALIZATION_A-00112.json; the durable task record appears only in later child commits. Re-emit the accepted material evidence and its task record together under one new immutable RESULT_SHA.

Its work-order dimensions are 2048x2048, 2048x2048, 4096x2048 and 2048x1024 for indices 26/28/30/32, while canonical inventory.csv records 2048x2047, 2047x2048, 1024x512 and 2048x1024 respectively; index32's dimensions match but its canonical source identity is still not proven by the Release work order. Rebuild the four work orders from exact canonical HD inventory sources and emit material+task record under one durable RESULT_SHA.
